question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the appointment of ad-hoc judges?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 127**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 127**

 
 
• Article 127 deals with the **appointment of ad-hoc judges**.
 
• **Adhoc judges **are appointed by the **chief justice of India **in the constitution with the president of India.
 
• The retired judges of the supreme court can be appointed as **Adhoc judge****s **but they are not deemed to be judges.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 125** - Salaries, etc., of Judges
 
• **Article 126** - Appointment of acting Chief Justice
 
• **Article 128 **- Attendance of retired Judges at sittings of the Supreme Court
